purpose: Documentation-only, owner-actionable release-control system for the two Mark 2 hub candidates. Supersedes no prior document -- adds a precise gate model and evidence ledger on top of docs/ecosystem-release-matrix.md and docs/mark-2-ecosystem-handoff.md. No merge, deploy, DNS, Cloudflare, or external-service action is authorized by this file's existence.

gateModel.G3: Domain, DNS, custom-domain, and legacy-host conflict verification
gateModel.G4: Public-output controls: robots, sitemap, canonical, metadata, redirects
gateModel.G6: Conversion, contact, tracking, privacy, and operational-readiness review
gateModel.G7: Build, test, accessibility, link, and output-scan evidence

terminologyReconciliation.Live candidate: Eligible to pursue release only after every gate below reaches Completed and G8 (owner release authorization) is explicitly granted. Does NOT mean currently live, currently deployed, or currently reachable at its production hostname. As of this packet, neither hub is live -- both are release candidates with open gates.
terminologyReconciliation.Building / Private/Building: A real repository and/or active work exists; nothing is deployed to a public hostname the property claims as its own. Does not imply active services, responsiveness, enrollment, fulfillment, clinical support, legal advice, membership access, or transaction capability of any kind, regardless of any code-level readiness.
terminologyReconciliation.External storefront / internally unaudit: The owner has indicated a real external property exists (e.g. HERO). Does not imply this project has verified its ownership, technical state, security, or operational status -- 'internally unaudited' means exactly that: no audit has occurred from this ecosystem's engineering side.
terminologyReconciliation.Route under TMI: Describes an intended navigational/informational relationship in the ecosystem map's presentation layer. Does not imply a currently deployed route, live redirect, or reachable destination unless that specific destination independently reaches G4 Completed for its own output.
